sample_rule: first byte SHA256(eventID) < 16, valid coordinates, coordinate uncertainty <=25 km
comparison: Compare supplied eventTime UTC offset with the offset of timezonefinder timezone_at(event coordinates) at the represented instant; also compare published eventDate and raw wall-clock hour to the coordinate-timezone-converted timestamp.

decision_rule.no_model_repair: If all or effectively all retained events have matching offsets and converted local date/hour equal the supplied wall-clock date/hour, retain current hour covariate semantics but document the audit.
decision_rule.model_repair: If material mismatch exists, freeze a timezone-aware event datetime repair before recomputing FrogID weather effects.
